capabilities: Scan all vaults and list installed plugins per vault
Push selected plugins from the current vault to other vaults
Pull plugins from a source vault after reviewing a diff
Optionally copy plugin settings (data.json) between vaults
Warn on downgrades and version conflicts before overwriting
disambiguation: Not a note or vault sync tool; it only copies plugin folders between vaults on one machine, not note content or devices.
extras: Desktop only (isDesktopOnly: true); no network access, data stays local. Bilingual English/Chinese README, though some command names appear only in Chinese; architecture docs live in docs/DESIGN.md.
motivation: The author maintains multiple vaults (work / life / demos) and had to install the same set of plugins over and over in each one.
problem: Obsidian stores plugins per vault, so people maintaining several vaults must reinstall the same plugins in each one by hand.

relations.evidence: pull mode uses the BRAT flow (loadManifests() + enablePluginAndSave(), takes effect immediately)

summary: Cross-vault plugin manager that pushes or pulls community plugins between your local vaults with a diff view and per-vault selection.
